inCameraSpotlight.heading: In-camera meeting detection
inCameraSpotlight.body: When a source identifies a committee meeting as in-camera, MapleSpike may surface that designation. Coverage and detail vary by source; this does not reveal non-public discussions.

features.subtitle: MapleSpike organizes selected records from configured sources. It does not review every public document; coverage and update schedules vary.

parliament.title: Parliament — HoC & Senate
parliament.body: Browse available House of Commons and Senate committee records. In-camera designations may appear when reported by a source; coverage and details vary.

gazette.title: Regulations — Canada Gazette
gazette.body: Explore available proposed and final regulations from Canada Gazette Parts I+II. Source coverage and update schedules vary; check the original publication for the current text.

influence.title: Corporate influence
influence.body: Explore selected lobbying records, government contracts, and public statements from configured sources. Coverage varies; verify records and context with the original publisher.

elections.title: Elections & Lobbying
elections.body: Browse selected third-party advertising, political-financing, and Ontario lobbying records where available. Coverage varies by source and jurisdiction.

networks.title: Influence networks
networks.body: Explore records about selected international organizations, think tanks, and NGOs. Available funding, lobbying, and relationship data varies by source.

oversight.title: Oversight & Courts
oversight.body: Explore selected court and oversight records where available. Coverage varies by source and is not a complete record of judicial or accountability activity.

connect.title: Connect the dots
connect.body: Where records support it, MapleSpike can connect people and organizations across committees, lobbying, contracts, and court data. Links and signal results depend on available records and may need independent review.

canadian.title: Built for Canadians, running in Canada
canadian.body: Information comes from sources such as Parliament, the Lobbying Registry, the Canada Gazette, open court data, and oversight bodies. Coverage, verification, and terms vary by source. Check the original sources.

aiIntegration.header: Use it with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok — or your own code
aiIntegration.subtitle: Connect compatible AI tools through MCP and ask questions about supported public-sector records. Coverage and returned evidence vary by source.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT
chatgpt.body: Connect via MCP in a compatible ChatGPT client. Ask about supported records and check returned source references against the original publications.

claude.title: Claude
claude.body: Connect through MCP in Claude Desktop or Claude Code. Ask about supported records and review returned citations against their original sources.

gemini.title: Gemini
gemini.body: Use MapleSpike as an MCP tool in compatible Gemini clients. Cross-reference supported records where the available data allows it.

grok.title: Grok
grok.body: Connect through xAI's function-calling API. Ask about supported records and review source references against original publications.

cursor.title: Cursor & Windsurf
cursor.body: Add the MCP endpoint URL to {cursorFile} or {windsurfFile}.

restApi.title: REST API
restApi.body: Direct HTTP access for backends, dashboards, and traditional apps.

apiRef.subtitle: API access with citation and record-integrity metadata where supplied by the endpoint. Fields and availability vary; check the source and publisher terms directly.

pricing.subtitle: Start for free. Scale as you grow. No hidden fees, no contracts, no surprise bills.

free.name: Free
free.description: For curious Canadians, hobbyists, and trying it out.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For journalists, researchers, and small dev teams.

business.name: Business
business.description: For newsrooms, civic orgs, and production apps.
features: Audit log export & available provenance metadata

enterprise.body: Enterprise options for government agencies and large organisations. Ask about self-hosting, usage limits, dedicated MCP service, audit exports, and provenance fields available for your use case.

footer.description: MapleSpike makes Canadian public data useful — for journalists, researchers, and anyone who wants to know what their government is doing. License terms vary by source and dataset; consult the original publisher terms.
